key_features: Home Discovery with Rotating Hero Carousel
Horizontal Row Categorized Browsing (Trending, Sci-Fi, Thriller, Top 10)
Advanced Search & Instant Filtering by Genre/Type
Immersive Movie & Series Details Modal / Page with Cast & Trailer
Demo Video Playback with custom cinematic video player & controls
My List (Watchlist management with local/backend sync)
Admin Dashboard for content management & analytics
Fully Responsive Navigation with Glassmorphism Header
universal_guidelines: Never use pure #000000 for backgrounds; use #0c0c0e for cinematic depth.
All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes for testing.
Ensure contrast ratio exceeds 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for interactive elements.
Glassmorphism headers must include backdrop-blur-xl and 1px subtle border.
No generic AI assistant emojis in headers or buttons.
